Low Earth Orbit
Steel Dragons
Hagane: Bridge
Tetsuya
Space transfer sequence complete.@Deviation from planned orbit: point two zero.
Eita
Hiryu Custom has transferred in, 4,000 astern of us.
Commander, moving to the rendezvous orbit@with the Kurogane designated by Major Gilliam.
Miles
Very well. I'll be in my quarters.@Contact me once the transfer of the mobile units@we entrusted to the Kurogane is complete.
Roger.
And make sure the work goes quickly.
...Still, it's good that Granteed and Touya@and the others came back to us.
Yeah.
I wonder if they were taken to@the Fury's home base after all.
I haven't heard the details either.@We'll probably get a report once we@link up with the Kurogane crew...
...Radar contact. One o'clock. It's the Kurogane.
Azuki
Message from the Kurogane. They're requesting@permission to dock. They also say someone@wishes to meet with the fleet commander.
Who?
They say they want to tell the commander that directly.
(Someone very important, then...?)
Hagane - Hangar
We made it back here again...
Katia
Yeah... When we were prisoners in Gaw-La Furia,@I had no idea what would happen to us.
Touya, good to have you back.
Kota...
Truth is, I wanted to get on the Kurogane@and go rescue you guys myself.
Akimi and the others told me.@You had something you had to do, Kota.
I suppose.
I'm so glad you're safe too, Katia.
I'm sorry, I made you worry.
Um... So were you two taken@to the Fury's home base after all?
Yes, that's right.
And yet you still managed to escape.@Splendidly done.
It's thanks to Granteed rescuing us.
Huh...?
You mean...@Granteed moved on its own?
Yes.
Apparently the soul of the Fury's god dwells@in Granteed. I think it moved on its own@because of that will...
I never knew...
So it ain't just the looks that are grandiose.
You've seen the new Granteed already?
Yup. It got real beefy, huh?@Big wings sproutin' from its back, and a wolf's face@on its chest.
Wait, isn't that a lion?
It's a dragon. In Gaw-La Furia, it combined@with a dragon-shaped machine called Basileus.@That's Granteed's true form.
Gaw-La...?
Is that the name of the Fury's base?
...I can't go into detail yet.@Major Gilliam told me to keep quiet.
Who told you all that in the first place?
I can't... say that either.
(It must be some very serious information...)
...Huh? Seriously, Roa?
Is Roa saying something?
Yeah. He says the powered-up Granteed@feels like the deity ship.
Deity ship...? What's that?
A big battleship Roa used to ride in.@Says a god from his world lived inside it.
My, so they have gods in common.
(Is it... just a coincidence?)
Tenia
The inside is pretty much the same as the Kurogane,@so it doesn't really feel like it's been a while.
I'm so glad you're safe too, Tenia.
Yeah. Sorry for making you worry so much.
So were you two taken@to the Fury's home base after all?
Yep.
It's thanks to Granteed@rescuing us.
You mean...@Granteed moved on its own?
Yeah.
The deity ship...
Melua
...Phew. I've been tense this whole time,@so it feels like I can finally catch my breath.
Let's see...
I'm so glad you're safe too, Melua.
I'm sorry for making you worry.
So were you two taken@to the Fury's home base after all?
Yes, that's right.
Yes, sir.
So this is the new Excellence...@The head, torso and arms are from the Striker.
Mizuho
Yes. The lower body and backpack are from@the Gunner Frame, which we'd only designed before.
I see. Gunner plus Striker@makes Gunstriker.
The Excellence was originally designed@to swap between several frames, right?
What about the Lightning and the Eternal?@Those two are the top-tier frames.
That's true, but this time we had to finish@the unit as fast as possible, and the stability of@the <Time Flow Engine> was the top priority...
So we decided to build two Strikers,@the Excellence's basic frame.
But it lacks versatility,@so we built in parts from the Gunner Frame@and a <Tesla Drive>.
That's why it's more agile than it looks.@Even without the backpack,@the main body can fly on its own.
By the way, didn't you say you'd erased@all the data on the Time Flow Engine?
Yes, that's right.
Then how...
Did you secretly keep a backup?
No, we didn't.@Even we can't erase the blueprints@in Raji's head and mine...
Jeez, you coulda told us beforehand that its@<Time Flow Engine> might break that trick@the Fury pulls.
Sorry...@Major Gilliam told me to keep it@top secret.
He didn't want to confuse us@with something uncertain?
Well, if we'd known, we'd have counted on it a lot.
We didn't know if it would actually work@until we tried it.
Jua-Mu ambushed the Kurogane and used that trick...@but Fiona and I could still move inside the barrier@in the Excellence Gunstriker.
And apparently Granteed Dracodeus@can do the same.
Then if the Fury use that trick from now on,@we can counter it?
I'm glad Katia is safe too...
Sure. When we went to the ruins of the@<Garden of Baral>, there was a pyramid Fatso built.
That bastard was gatherin'@Lamaris Kaana in there.
What...?!
We managed to take down Fatso...@but the Lamaris Kaana combined@into somethin' even bigger.
And on top of that,@the Skull Knight made off with it.
So what are they planning to do?
People think they mean to make@a lot more Lamaris, or help them@grow even further, but...
Nobody knows for sure.@Though I figure that giant Lamaris@is headed for the Dark Iron Castle.
By the way, about that powered-up Granteed.@Roa says it's got the same feel as@the big battleship he used to ride.
A battleship...
Yeah, called the deity ship...@Apparently the soul of a god from his world@lived inside it.
Huh...
What's up?
Something like that's true of Granteed too...@I heard the soul of the Fury's god dwells in it.
Huh... Maybe that's why they feel alike.
Hagane - Commander's Office
Letting three Gadisword natives fight with us...@Why did you approve Rätsel Feinschmecker's@decision?
I judged it a necessary measure@to resolve a number of problems.
In fact, we fought a Gadisword unit on the way@to the Moon, but Fairy, Sieg and Sally@showed no sign of leaving us...
And they've been cooperative in later operations too.
So you want me to approve it?
If possible, by recommending it to the Joint Chiefs.
(Even if I bury it here, it'll just get@reported to Lieutenant General Jacob Moore...)
...Very well. I'll consider it.
Next, the matter of meeting@with Princess Shana-Mia Eterna Fura.
...A hard story to believe on short notice.
But we have Touya Shiun's testimony...@and Granteed Dracodeus can serve@as physical evidence.
Even if it's true,@this is far beyond what we can handle at our level.@It's an extremely high-level political issue.
Of course, we must report it to the Joint Chiefs.@In all likelihood, she'll end up@being transferred to Earth, but...
I want to get information out of her while we can.@For the sake of the missions the Steel Dragons@will likely be involved in eventually.
...All right. I'll meet her.
Tsugumi
I see... So there were no clues@at the ruins of the <Garden of Baral>.
But I think it's actually a good thing@that <Irui> wasn't there.
Why?
On the surface there was a pyramid built by@Debudedabide, with Lamaris Kaana gathered inside.
The underground space was strewn with <Yokijin>@wreckage, and malice seemed to have pooled there.@We think the Lamaris absorbed it, but...
That place was like a graveyard.
You saw it yourself?
Yes. We surveyed the underground part with KoRyuOh.
There were no life signs...@and I couldn't sense any thoughts@that might have been Irui's.
(Irui... Where are you now...?)
Hagane - Briefing Room
...A pleasure to meet you. I am Brigadier General@Miles Boothroyd, commander of the 1st Independent@Special Forces Unit under the Joint Chiefs.
Shana-Mia
I am Shana-Mia Eterna Fura...@of the imperial family that rules the Fury.
I should mention that present here@are not only my unit's commanding officers,@but other concerned parties as well.
I understand.@Let me say this first of all...@I have no wish to fight the people of Earth any longer.
You said "I."@Meaning that is Your Highness's personal will,@not the consensus of the Fury?
Yes... At present, Gu-Landon Gortz, Knight Commander@of the Furia Holy Knights, has seized control@of our nation.
Hmm...@First of all, what exactly are you, the Fury?
...Long ago, the Fury were an empire@that flourished in a faraway star system.
But a great catastrophe cost us our home world and@many of our brethren. The few who survived escaped@aboard the colossal spaceship Gaw-La Furia...
And after wandering space, we reached Earth.
When was this?
...Let us say several thousand years ago.
Then you're descendants of Fury@who came to Earth long ago?
We have hardly gone through any generations.@That's because we have repeatedly undergone@extremely long-term artificial hibernation.
Why would you do that...?
So that we ourselves might one day return home...@and so that our power and technology would not@be lost over the generations.
(And for that they managed thousands of years@of artificial hibernation...)
(We've got the <Earth Cradle> and the Moon Cradle@on Earth, but this is on a whole other level...)
What led you to that decision?@You said earlier that you lost your home world...
It all began with ruins on our home world,@the Ru-Kuku Vodyu... the Gate of Voda.@You call it the Cross Gate.
Wha...!
(I knew there was more than one of them...@So one existed on the Fury's home world too.)
While we were investigating the Gate of Voda,@the <Vaula> appeared, and our world fell into chaos.
Their form differed from what you later encountered@on Earth, but their goal was to gather the malice@of intelligent life...
And to manifest that which endlessly returns the@endlessly expanding universe to primordial darkness.
(Same as the <Ruina>.)
Despite our valiant efforts, our world was overrun@by the Vaula, who appeared in endless numbers...
The survivors fled to the fleet of ships@led by Gaw-La Furia.
Then Father, Gu-Landon and the others planned a final@operation: the Furia Holy Knights, led by the Throne@Units, would storm and destroy the Gate of Voda.
And did you manage to destroy the Cross Gate?
We don't know.
What do you mean?
In the final stage, my father and the Knights had to@withdraw. The attack on the Gate of Voda led to the@worst possible outcome: our home world's collapse.
The fleet escaped by space transfer.@But it seems that when the planet broke apart, space-@time was distorted, or some force tied to the Gate...
And we were flung into an unknown region of space,@far, far from our star system.
(An unplanned ultra-long-distance transfer...@Similar to what happened with the <Rabulpaila>.)
We tried many times to return to our home world,@but to this day we have never succeeded. So we don't@know what became of the Gate of Voda.
I see...
While wandering space in search of our home world,@Gaw-La Furia discovered the solar system.@And we learned of Earth, a world that could support life.
Our survey revealed that intelligent life of the same@type as us... that is, Earthlings, had built a civilization...
And that the <Gate of Voda> existed in Antarctica,@which was still unexplored at the time.
We were stunned by that discovery.@And we cursed our fate.@We had met the source of the catastrophe once again.
Do the Fury know why the Cross Gate was made,@when, and by whom?
No, it's an unknown to us as well...@but I have one idea.
Which is?
In Fury mythology, there is a passage where the creator@god Fureim descended from the heavens with a dragon@through a circular gate and came down to the land.
The creator god...?
The god who created the Fury long ago and granted us@wisdom and power... a giant crowned with a halo.
A giant crowned with a halo... Just like Granteed.
Yes. It's a mobile weapon made in Fureim's image,@a mechanical guardian deity handed down@through the imperial family for generations.
And inside it is housed@the divine body in which the god's soul dwells.
A god's soul...? Is that true?
Even among the Fury, some have their doubts.
Clifford
...How does the mythology describe the creator god's@soul coming to dwell in the divine body?
After the Fury people built their first civilization,@Fureim became its unshakable foundation@and fell into slumber.
At that time, it's said he left these words:@"When the hour of the great trial comes,@I shall awaken once more."
(A trial...)
The land where the creator god slept became@the center of civilization, and after rising and@falling through the ages, it became our capital.
It's also said that over the long passage of time,@Fureim's body became one with the earth,@until only a crimson jewel remained.
That's the divine body?
Yes. It was originally kept inside a temple...@but now it is housed within Granteed's@battle throne.
Then does the mythology go into detail@about the circular gate Fureim appeared through?
No...
So it seems it's only a legend in the end.
But the Throne Units do have supernatural power...@And the only ones who can pilot them are descendants@of the first emperor, called the child of Fureim...
The head of the imperial family, and the head of@the Shune family, who serve for generations as its@guard, the Sentinel Commander.
Shune? Don't tell me...
It's my father's family name.
Then you're...
It's not just me. Katia, Tenia and Melua are@also half Earthling, half Fury.
Those girls too...
Seriously? That's...!
Yes.@That's probably why we could@use the Cytron System.
(Now that you mention it, a lot of things add up.)
(So Father's prediction was right...)
Princess Shana-Mia,@would you also explain the matter@of Touya Shiun and the others?
Yes, in order...@After we discovered the Gate of Voda in Antarctica,@the Vaula emerged from it.
We had anticipated their attack,@so we intercepted them at once, but...
After a fierce battle, most of the Knights fell,@and Gaw-La Furia was badly damaged.
My father boarded the Throne Unit with E-Selda Shune@and joined the decisive battle at the Gate of Voda...
But facing a mighty enemy, I'm told, he was driven@so far that he had to prepare himself for death.
(A mighty enemy...@Something of the same kind as <Perfectio>,@the King of Ruin?)
However, the Throne Unit unleashed a supernatural@power that held that enemy back and closed@the Gate of Voda.
Granteed had that kind of power...
But it didn't activate during the battle@on the Fury's home world, did it?
Then why on Earth...?
There are two theories about that.
In the first battle with the Vaula, my father and the@others obtained a device they used to sense the@thoughts and emotions of intelligent life.
(The "key" that <Perfectio> spoke of...?)
They modified it and built it into the Cytron System@of the Throne Units and Knight units, to detect the@Vaula's presence and movements in battle.
(In other words, a distorted version of the "key"...)
As a result, all those at the Antarctic battle... not just@Father, E-Selda and the Knights, but the Vaula too...@resonated and clashed strongly through the system.
It's thought that the violent surge of positive and@negative thought awakened the soul of Fureim in the@Throne Unit, unleashing the power to seal the Gate.
(Resonance before the King of Ruin...@That rings a bell.)
(That time... In the final battle with Perfectio,@the power of human feelings, of life, that we@brought forth... The only thing that could resist it...)
(If the Cytron System is the original@of the <Sympathia> that was the key to that,@then Granteed could do the same...)
(No, it wouldn't be strange if it could do even more.)
And the other theory...@My father and the others suspected that@some factor lies with Earth itself.
What do you mean?
I feel this planet is a special place that draws in@those with rare fates and ties, and makes them cross.
In fact, it seems we weren't the first@visitors from another world...
We also found traces of supernatural beings@waging battles in many places.
That's...
Could the former be <Gan Eden>...@and the latter the war between <Baral> and@the Hundred Evils, the Great Mech War?
Either way, I believe a great power of fate@is at work on Earth.
That may be one of the reasons you were able@to seal the Gate of Voda in the recent@great war.
(If that's true, then Chris and Ventus,@who went to the other side...)
Let me return to the story.@After the battle with the <Vaula> ended,@my father and the others studied the Gate of Voda...
But every probe sent to the other side@was lost without a trace.
But we and the Ares Geist...
That's a first for us as well. It may be due@to the great power of fate I mentioned earlier.
So we're the exception of exceptions...
Passing through the Cross Gate@requires some kind of condition or factor...
The unmanned probes the survey team sent to the@other side after the Sealing War didn't have it,@so they couldn't come back.
Then how do you explain the Cross Gates@of the <Endless Frontier>, which allow some@travel back and forth?
This is only a guess, but the gates in that world@may be simplified copies of the ones we know...
Or ones that someone had adjusted@and was controlling.
Then what are those conditions or factors@for passing through the Cross Gate@you mentioned, Major?
The fragments of false memories Euzeth once spoke of,@rebirth after a Great Kalpa... or the experience@of crossing between parallel worlds or dimensions...
Those may be brands stamped on our bodies,@proof that we can pass through the Cross Gate.
You can't say that's true@of everyone in the Steel Dragons, can you?
Yeah, there are probably other factors too.
What you said earlier... a Great Kalpa, rebirth,@false memories... What do they mean?
A Great Kalpa is the whole process from a world's@birth to its extinction...
Rebirth means being born again in the new world@after a Great Kalpa, with a similar appearance,@temperament, abilities and karmic ties...
And false memories are memories from before@that rebirth... memories of a past life, so to speak.
I see...@We have similar ideas in our world as well.
Then please, go on.
Yes.@My father and the others feared that repeated@interference with the Gate would bring the Vaula back...
So they built the sealed shrine Zig-Gaze Vodyu@beneath the Antarctic ice to physically cut@the Gate off from the outside world.
(So that's <Fabula Foresse>...)
(I used to think that whoever built those ruins@came out of the Cross Gate,@but I was wrong.)
(But some questions still remain...)
The reason you didn't destroy the Cross Gate...@Was it because you didn't want the tragedy@of the Fury's home world repeated on Earth?
That's right.@None of the expeditions sent to find our home world@returned, so my father gave up on going back.
And to protect Earth, a land where we might@take refuge, he kept watch over the Gate of Voda...
And resolved to one day cut off@the catastrophe at its root.
(Not sealing the King of Ruin,@but wiping it out...?)
Building Zig-Gaze Vodyu, with its monitors and defense@systems for the Gate of Voda, took several years,@and the younger generation like me was born then.
After the shrine was built, my father hid Gaw-La Furia@deep beneath the Moon, and most of us went into a long@sleep in a hibernation facility, the Grove of Timefaring.
After that, a few of us woke in turns for set periods@to survey the state of the Earth and maintain@Gaw-La and the sealed shrine.
So you were bystanders@to the history of humanity.
I suppose you could say that.
But if you'd wanted to, couldn't you have ruled...@or wiped out our ancestors,@and taken Earth for yourselves?
When we arrived on Earth, my father@forbade any interference with humanity.
That was out of respect for the native people...@and also to protect the purity of Fury blood.
Then what are we...?@Me, Katia, Tenia and Melua...?
You are... the children of the Assimilation Plan@that E-Selda Shune was carrying out.
The Assimilation... Plan?
Yes.@A plan to bring the Fury a new future...
...Explain it to me.
This goes back a long time...@You know of the two meteorites that fell@to Earth nearly 200 years ago, don't you?
Yeah, I learned about them in history class.@Meteor 1 fell on New York,@and Meteor 2 fell on Moscow...
That ended the Old Calendar era,@and the world changed drastically.
It was an important event for us too...@The Fury leadership woke from hibernation@to discuss what to do next.
What to do...?
The disaster and chaos from the two meteorites made@Earthlings' negative emotions swell, and there was@a danger that it would stir up the Gate of Voda.
We watched over the state of the Earth@for about a year... but then my father@fell gravely ill and passed away.
As his heir, I succeeded him,@and after confirming nothing was amiss with the@Gate of Voda, I went back into hibernation.
After that, Earthlings expanded to the Moon and@other planets... and there came a chance they'd find@not only Gaw-La Furia, but the sealed shrine as well.
So about 20 years ago, we awoke again@and discussed various countermeasures.
E-Selda and I, knowing full well it went@against my father's wishes, argued for coexistence@between the Fury and the people of Earth.
Because by clinging to the status quo of our race,@we had become stagnant... and we believed@that would lead to our decline.
...As a member of the Fury's imperial family,@shouldn't you value bloodlines above all?
I have not cast aside my pride as a Fury.@But thousands of years have passed@since we lost our home world...
Earth and the Moon are all but our second home now...@We should accept that, reveal the truth to the native@people of Earth, and ask to coexist with them.
Otherwise, the Fury have no future.@And to root out the catastrophe of the Gate of Voda,@we will need the strength of the people of Earth.
But Gu-Landon and the others, who wanted to keep@Fury blood pure, opposed our ideas.
So E-Selda proposed the Assimilation Plan.@It called for Fury and Earthlings to have children...
And to study what kind of abilities@those children would come to have.
...Isn't that exactly what Gu-Landon@would loathe most?
Yes... but E-Selda wanted to establish as fact@that the Fury and the people of Earth@are extremely close to one another.
I overrode the objections of Gu-Landon and the others@and allowed the Assimilation Plan to proceed...
And four people, E-Selda among them, left@Gaw-La Furia and made contact with Ashurey Kreuzer,@which had only just been founded.
And that's where you got those masks@to pass as Earthlings?
...Yes.@And E-Selda and the others each@had one child.
You said you'd study what abilities Touya and the@others had. Could it be that the Bellzelute...
Was developed to confirm whether Katia, Tenia@and Melua could adapt to the Cytron System?
Not only that. E-Selda and Al-Van@were also seeking a fusion of Fury@and Earth technology.
With the goal of making Ashurey Kreuzer@produce your weapons, I suppose?
Yes, to prepare for the battle with the Vaula...@The Bellzelute development project@was the forerunner of that.
With the Cytron Control System, those girls should've@been able to move the Bellzelute on their own.@So why did you need me?
A secret test beforehand predicted that their@ability to adapt to the system might be low.
So, just in case, we needed someone@who could pilot the Bellzelute.
(So I was the insurance...)
Then when I first got into Granteed alone,@the reason I couldn't move it was...
Perhaps your ability to adapt to the system@had not fully awakened.
(So that's why it moved once Katia got in...)
Then why was Jua-Mu at Ashurey?
Gu-Landon sent him there@to keep watch on the Assimilation Plan.
(And while he was at it, he learned how to handle@Earth's mobile weapons... from me, of all people.)
Shana-Mia...@Why did my dad escape from Gaw-La Furia@in Granteed?
And I'd like to hear why So-Des@attacked Ashurey.
E-Selda took the Throne Unit@out of Gaw-La Furia...
Because he learned that Gu-Landon and Chief Agent@Karo-Ran Vui had begun moving to crush@the Assimilation Plan.
Crush the plan...?@Why at that particular moment?
If Katia, Tenia and Melua were proven@able to adapt to the Cytron Control System...
The Assimilation Plan's legitimacy would be established.@For those who revere pure Fury blood,@that had to be prevented at all costs...
They hadn't openly sabotaged it in front of me, but@once they knew the result would be unwelcome,@they must have resorted to force.
But my dad didn't make it in time...
No...@We only noticed what Gu-Landon and the others@were scheming just before they acted...
Why did you let Granteed sortie?@Isn't it your trump card?
It is Gu-Landon's as well.@That's why I entrusted it to E-Selda.
A desperate measure, huh...
But it allowed us to draw@the Fury's attention.
